run_f_gold: run f_gold to count minimum flips needed to make a binary matrix symmetric
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs and compare results with expected output
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold iterates over upper triangle pairs to count asymmetric entries
review_f_gold: review f_gold logic that compares mat[i][j] with mat[j][i] for each pair
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept matrix dimensions automatically instead of passing n as a parameter
